AK 702*76

DONE 702

AK 703*71
DATA 703 IO MOTOR_LEFT ON
DATA 703 IO MOTOR_RIGHT ON
DATA 703 IO LED ON
DATA 703 IO BUZZER ON
DATA 703 IO SONAR_LEFT_TRIG ON
DATA 703 IO SONAR_RIGHT_TRIG ON
DATA 703 IO SONAR_LEFT_ECHO ON
DATA 703 IO SONAR_RIGHT_ECHO ON
DATA 703 IO ENCODER_LEFT ON
DATA 703 IO ENCODER_RIGHT ON
DATA 703 IO TOUCH_TOP ON
DATA 703 IO TOUCH_LEFT ON
DATA 703 IO TOUCH_RIGHT ON
DATA 703 IO TOUCH_REAR ON
DONE 703

AK 704*64
DATA 704 HW STATE 1128 IDLE 0 0 16383
DATA 704 HW ML 0 0 0 1 0 0
DATA 704 HW MR 0 0 0 1 0 0
DATA 704 HW EL 1 1 0 0.0 P
DATA 704 HW ER 1 1 0 0.0 P
DATA 704 HW SL 1 1 0 40.0 40.0 P
DATA 704 HW SR 1 1 0 -1.0 -1.0 P
DATA 704 HW T TOP 1 1 0 P
DATA 704 HW T LEFT 1 1 0 P
DATA 704 HW T RIGHT 1 1 0 P
DATA 704 HW T REAR 1 1 0 P
DATA 704 HW OUT 1 0 -1 1 0 0
DATA 704 HW FRONT -1.0 HOST
DONE 704 TELEMETRY

AK 705*63
DATA 705 STATUS IDLE LED=OFF BUZZER=OFF DEBUG=OFF INPUT_MODE=LIVE MOTOR_MODE=LIVE
DONE 705
